description: Application-owned zero-network replay of one fixed local Kentucky SOS company-family package into an operation-scoped private local-review release.
redirect_policy: No network requests or redirects are permitted.
retry: No automatic retry; inspect the terminal receipt and explicitly correct or replace the local package.
checkpoint: A UUID operation owns its immutable input snapshot, manifest-last private release, start record, and terminal receipt.
idempotency: Independent verification reparses the fixed snapshot and requires byte-identical normalized output and hashes.
cancellation: Cooperative cancellation removes only the operation-owned snapshot and unpublished release, then writes CANCELLED.
retention_profile: Person-bearing raw input and minimized output remain private local-review-only; no public export or national admission.
